Solution B is correct. The interior is $-5<x<5$ and $-4<y<4$, so $x\in\{-4,\dots,4\}$ (9 values) and $y\in\{-3,\dots,3\}$ (7 values), giving $9\times 7=63$.

Solution A makes an error when it excludes the boundary. It removes the axes from the count, but interior points on the axes, such as $(0,0)$ or $(1,0)$, are strictly inside the rectangle. It only counts points with both coordinates nonzero, so it undercounts. Its answer of 48 is wrong.

WINNER: B
